ag.taunt.shrug._orig: the shrug held: the shoulders up, the palms open and turned up away from the body, the chin lifted: "is that all"

ag.taunt.settle._orig: dropping back to the stance, the head still a little cocked

ag.embed.lie._orig: driven into the floor of the crater on his back: the limbs slack, the head rolled to one side, the hands open

ag.embed.stir._orig: coming to: one hand bringing itself up from the floor, the head lifting

ag.embed.brace._orig: the hands to the floor and a knee drawn up: the push that the get-up takes over from

ag.hold.charge_heavy._orig: the heavy charge: both forearms side by side ahead of him, parallel and never crossed, the head tucked behind them, the body one low line

ag.hold.charge_peel._orig: a feint peeling off: side-on to the line and braking, the leading arm swung wide, one knee drawn up

ag.hold.kb_short._orig: driven back on his heels: the chest back, the arms out for balance, the feet skidding

ag.hold.kb_long._orig: a long slide: sat back low on the heels, the feet wide, the arms flung out

ag.hold.kb_drift._orig: pushed back off his feet: floating, the arms loose, the legs trailing a little
